newsitem.title: UK: Finelist falls as newspaper advises "sell".
newsitem.headline: Finelist falls as newspaper advises "sell".

text.p: Shares in car parts distributor Finelist Group Plc dropped on Monday after the Mail on Sunday newspaper recommended investors took profits in the group's shares, dealers said.
Finelist shares fell 13p to 325-1/2p by 0956 GMT in volume of 75,000 shares.
The newspaper said the group's acquisitive strategy was "risky" and added fears that Tomkins Plc could sell its holding of around 2.1 million Finelist shares next year, weighing on the share price.
Tomkins acquired the holding following its disposal of Ferraris Piston Service Ltd to Finelist for 52 million stg in January.
Both Finelist and Tomkins were unavailable for immediate comment on the newspaper article.
